name: Poisonous Pollen Trap
description: Flowers carved into the door emit colorful pollen when the door is touched.
disable: DC 26 Thievery (expert) to deface the flower carvings, DC 25 Nature (expert) to neutralize the pollen, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the conjuration

offensiveAbilities.name: Pollinate
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The door is touched, or the lock is opened

Effect The flowers spray poisonous pollen in a 30ft Cone. A creature in the area must attempt a DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save, with the following effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (2d10+11) Poison Damage damage and becomes Enfeebled 2.

Failure The creature takes (3d10+16) Poison Damage damage and 1d10 Persistent,poison Damage damage, becomes enfeebled 2, and takes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks for 1d4 hours.

Critical Failure The creature takes (4d10+22) Poison Damage damage and 1d10 Persistent,poison Damage damage, becomes Enfeebled 4, and takes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks and saves against poison for 24 hours.
